findings: Complete unscaled source execution, independent initial-byte lookup, high-nibble-first interleave, active output readbacks and complete memory frame are proved for arbitrary count/block/pid. The wrapper BLOCK512 case is included.

ActiveBytes constrains only genuinely active uint8 cells to their storage-width invariant. Masked-off memory and arbitrary undef are unrestricted; final memory is proved independent of undef within that domain.

Two uint8 wrap steps, signed32 shifts/OR, runtime fp32 bitcast and genuine bf16 conversion all remain in the executable source. The final memory is unconditionally independent of fallback Algebra callbacks.

All16 nibble/all256 byte helper proofs are connected to complete execution; the actual-source witnesses cover alias+negative-zero+tail and BLOCK512/nonzero pid/all256 bytes+tail. Four independent reference audits exclude source execution.

Output cells carry a bf16 tag with a zero-extended16bit encoding in the Word container. Logical cell alias/frame semantics are not silently identified with native byte aliasing or cross-program scheduling.

The source equals the frozen Lean translation probe by kernel-checked rfl. Original-Python offline compilation is linked separately; no general Python translator/compiler/native-value theorem is asserted.
Native physical storage, instructions/FTZ/rounding, signed address width, allocation/launch and cross-program composition remain explicit bindings. GPU was not executed.
